caption: The video showcases a tight close-up of an aircraft propeller, its dark glossy spinner cone marked with small specks and a diagonal light streak, surrounded by long blades tipped in yellow and gold against a heavily blurred cityscape of tall buildings. Throughout the excerpt, the blade cluster rotates steadily clockwise, the tips sweeping across the frame. The blades remain sharply defined with no motion-blur disc, indicating a slow spin. The framing remains static on the hub, the spinner cone occupying a consistent portion of the image. The dark lower air-intake opening with its pale yellow rim is visible at the bottom. The blurred background remains unchanged, with no obvious camera movement alongside the apparent rotation.
relations: Static hub and spinner cone anchor the frame while blades rotate clockwise around the central axis.
Yellow-tipped blade edges sweep across the blurred cityscape without motion-blur disc, indicating slow steady rotation.
The lower air-intake with pale yellow rim stays visible and fixed beneath the rotating blade cluster.
Background tall buildings remain unchanged, preserving identity as the propeller assembly turns in place.
